comments.text: There is so much that is great in this mix, but I love what Andre does with Patra "Romantic Call", starting around 32:09.  It's just really fun to listen to. Not sure what version that is, but it's cool. Andre's music collection is interesting.  It took me forever to find this video again. I watched over a year ago, then went ADHD and forgot all about it. Randomly, my brain tossed out this urgent idea that I have to find this DJ again. I scrolled down a bajillion videos on here to find this. I think it took me more than a half hour of searching. Chuckling about some of the most outrageous outfits on some DJ's as a scrolled , but still searching until I found Andre again. I should write "Andre Dancekowski" on the wall of my house. It is that important!  And now I am super rewarded with 42:28 "You're the dimedropper!" which was what stuck in my ADHD brain for over a year, evidently. haha
